correctness.rationale: PASS for fixed k>=2 and fixed color rank s>=1, q=2^s. Exact parity constraint on each (k+2)-set identifies all even (k+1)-face maps with q^{C(n-1,k)} independent root k-face labels. A transposition has root coordinate orbit deficit a=C(n-3,k-1), hence fixed probability exactly q^-a. For nontranspositions with a fixed root, support/cycle orbit inequalities give >=(3/2)a for supports 3,4 and >=3t a/8 for 5<=t<=epsilon n; large support gives Omega(n^k). For derangements, equivariance of the simplicial boundary/coboundary map bounds invariant face-code dimension by number of k-subset orbits, again Omega(n^k) defect. Two distinct transpositions impose at least 2C(n-5,k-1) independent constraints and so Bonferroni overlap is lower order. Thus P(nonrigid)=C(n,2)q^-a(1+o(1)), and Burnside gives the relative isomorphism-count correction. Independently constructed rooted even-face masks and binary equation ranks for every permutation on 6 vertices with k=2; all 15 transpositions have defect C(3,1)=3; finite permutation check does not prove the asymptotic.
residual_risks: Fixed k,s only: q power of 2, named colours, k>=2; no uniform growing-parameter result and no automorphisms permuting the colours. Exact old k=2 q=2 two-graph counts are credited.
